sec: sec:A002: Establish output data policy / Control mays

blocks.id: blk:A002: Establish output data policy / Control mays/1
blocks.text: Implementing technical controls to enforce AI output opt-in/opt-out and deletion policies. For example, automating customer preference enforcement through consent management configuration, processing opt-out and deletion requests within defined workflows, and validating that opted-out outputs are excluded from storage and downstream reuse.
